headline: AlphaFold-class predictions are stress-tested and augmented with external evidence and applied at scale
label: Alphafold Reliability And Applications
summary: New benchmarks show inter-tool agreement is not validity, while templates and epitope guidance raise antibody-antigen success and proteome-scale uses expand.
synthesis: The dominant thread is how far AlphaFold-class predictions can be trusted and improved with external information. A fusion-protein benchmark finds that agreement among four tools does not indicate biological plausibility. Antibody-antigen work supplies external information: PIPER docking templates raise AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 success from 56.2% to 63.4% on a leakage-free set, APEs uses retrieved evidence to predict epitopes that steer modelling, and a nanobody benchmark finds AF3 leads with ipTM and CDR3 pLDDT cutoffs useful for filtering. A perspective reports that explicit potassium ions shift AF3 predictions. Applications include AlphaPPM/MembranomeX across 18 organisms, organism-specific signatures in 373,779 structures, and host-pathogen mimicry modelling with binding-assay validation of 8 cases. GSP (RNA scoring) and CoEVFold (coevolution visualisation) are adjacent tooling.
